class.name: GFResourceRegistryAssetSourceProvider
class.description: GFResourceRegistryAssetSourceProvider: 从 GFResourceRegistry 生成资产目录的 provider。 该 provider 把已有资源注册表条目适配为 `GFAssetCatalogEntry`，用于项目从 “稳定资源 ID -> 资源路径” 平滑过渡到更高层的资产目录。字段含义仍由项目定义。

member.name: registry
member.description: 作为来源的资源注册表。

tags.tag: entry_options: Dictionary with optional title_fields, description_fields, tag_fields, category_fields, and preview_path_fields.

member.name: configure_registry
member.signature: func configure_registry( p_registry: GFResourceRegistry, p_source_id: StringName = &"resource_registry", options: Dictionary = {} ) -> GFResourceRegistryAssetSourceProvider:

tags.tag: options: 可选项，支持 priority 和 entry_options。
options: Dictionary with optional priority: int and entry_options: Dictionary.
options: 可选项，支持 asset_ids、entry_ids 和 entry_options。
options: Dictionary with optional asset_ids, entry_ids, and entry_options.
return: Dictionary with source_id, priority, provider_class, registry_entry_count, and has_registry.
